events.title: Propagating Native Plants for Your Backyard
events.location: Maroochy Regional Bushland Botanic Garden, Tanawha
events.description: A hands-on workshop focused on the techniques required to propagate local native plant species, held at the dedicated Arts & Ecology Centre. Participants will learn practical botanical skills suitable for home gardening and environmental conservation.

events.title: Vibecamp 2026
events.description: A multi-day intellectual and social gathering designed for curious people to share ideas, host discussions, and participate in community-driven workshops in an outdoor, relaxed setting. The event focuses on fostering authentic connections between intellectually engaged attendees.
